say: Here the swimmer must swim to the light and
touch it, as Objectives says.
Fear turned away from the light. To charge it,
the same parts are wired the other way round:
click the Board tab.
Build what the shadows show: two eyes looking
ahead, two thrusters, and each eye wired to the
thruster on the other side, the wires crossed.
Before you run it, try it: open Diagnostic, the
stethoscope in the bar, or press D.
The main screen runs your board where the
swimmer stands on the map. Drag it, the light
to one side: that eye reads more, drives the
thruster across, and the swimmer turns to it.
Now run it: the Run tab, Run at the bottom
left, or Space.
Press Play, or Space: it charges the light.
Crossed, the wires turn the swimmer toward the
light: that is aggression. Next level when you
are ready.
